name: Ticket
description: Core entity representing support tickets with full lifecycle tracking including status, priority, assignment, and resolution details

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief summary of the ticket issue

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the ticket (New, Assigned, In Progress, Resolved, Closed, Reopened)

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level of the ticket (Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: category
fields.description: Category or type of the ticket (Hardware, Software, Network, Access, Other)

fields.name: assignedAgentId
fields.description: ID of the support agent assigned to the ticket

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: ID of the customer who submitted the ticket

name: User
description: Stores user information for customers, agents, and managers with role-based access and authentication data

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: userName
fields.description: Full name of the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and notifications

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role: customer, agent, or manager

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department the user belongs to

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

name: TicketCategory
description: Lookup entity for standardized ticket categories enabling consistent classification and routing

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticket category

fields.name: categoryName
fields.description: Display name of the category (e.g., Hardware, Software, Network)

fields.name: categoryDescription
fields.description: Detailed description of what issues fall under this category

fields.name: defaultPriority
fields.description: Default priority level assigned to tickets in this category (Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: defaultAssignmentGroup
fields.description: Default team or group to route tickets in this category

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether this category is currently available for ticket classification

name: EscalationRule
description: Configuration entity storing rules for automatic ticket escalation based on priority, age, or other criteria

fields.name: ruleId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the escalation rule

fields.name: ruleName
fields.description: Descriptive name of the escalation rule

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Ticket priority level this rule applies to (e.g., Low, Medium, High, Critical)

fields.name: thresholdHours
fields.description: Number of hours before escalation is triggered

fields.name: escalationAction
fields.description: Action to take when rule is triggered (e.g., NotifyManager, ReassignTicket, IncreasePriority)

fields.name: notifyRoles
fields.description: Comma-separated list of user roles to notify upon escalation

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether this escalation rule is currently active

constraints.priority: Must match valid ticket priority values
constraints.escalationAction: Must be a valid escalation action type

name: TicketComment
description: Stores chronological comments, notes, and updates added to tickets by agents, managers, or customers throughout the ticket lifecycle

fields.name: commentId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the comment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the parent ticket

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who created the comment

fields.name: commentText
fields.description: The actual content of the comment or note

fields.name: commentType
fields.description: Type of comment (e.g., note, update, resolution, customer_feedback)

fields.name: isInternal
fields.description: Flag indicating if comment is internal (visible only to agents) or public (visible to customer)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the comment was created

relationships.description: Each comment belongs to one ticket
Each comment is created by one user

indexes.name: idx_ticket_comments
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments for a specific ticket in chronological order

indexes.name: idx_user_comments
indexes.description: Optimize retrieval of comments by user

commentType.description: Restrict comment types to predefined values

name: TicketAttachment
description: Store file attachments and supporting documents for tickets

fields.name: attachmentId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the attachment

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the associated ticket

fields.name: fileName
fields.description: Original name of the uploaded file

fields.name: fileSize
fields.description: Size of the file in bytes

fields.name: fileType
fields.description: MIME type of the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf)

fields.name: filePath
fields.description: Storage path or URL where the file is stored

fields.name: uploadedBy
fields.description: User ID of the person who uploaded the attachment

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the file was uploaded

relationships.description: Each attachment belongs to one ticket
Each attachment is uploaded by one user

indexes.name: idx_ticket_id
indexes.description: Index for efficient retrieval of all attachments for a ticket

indexes.name: idx_uploaded_by
indexes.description: Index for tracking attachments by uploader

name: TicketHistory
description: Audit entity capturing every state transition, field modification, and significant event in a ticket's lifecycle for compliance and analysis

fields.name: historyId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history record

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket being modified

fields.name: changedBy
fields.description: User ID who made the change

fields.name: changeType
fields.description: Type of change (STATUS_CHANGE, FIELD_UPDATE, ASSIGNMENT, ESCALATION, COMMENT_ADDED, REOPENED)

fields.name: fieldName
fields.description: Name of the field that was changed (null for non-field changes)

fields.name: oldValue
fields.description: Previous value before the change

fields.name: newValue
fields.description: New value after the change

fields.name: changedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the change occurred

relationships.description: Each history record belongs to one ticket
Each history record is created by one user

indexes.name: idx_ticket_history_ticket_id
indexes.description: Fast lookup of all history records for a specific ticket

indexes.name: idx_ticket_history_change_type
indexes.description: Filter history by type of change

constraints.retentionPolicy: Retain indefinitely for compliance and audit purposes

name: NotificationLog
description: Audit entity recording all email notification events sent by the system for troubleshooting and compliance tracking

fields.name: notificationId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification log entry

fields.name: ticketId
fields.description: Reference to the ticket that triggered the notification

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address of the notification recipient

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (e.g., TICKET_CREATED, TICKET_ASSIGNED, TICKET_ESCALATED, TICKET_RESOLVED, TICKET_REOPENED)

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Email subject line of the notification

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was sent

fields.name: status
fields.description: Delivery status of the notification (SENT, FAILED, PENDING)

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.description: Error details if notification delivery failed

relationships.description: Links notification to the associated ticket

indexes.name: idx_ticket_id
indexes.description: Index for querying notifications by ticket

indexes.name: idx_sent_at
indexes.description: Index for chronological queries and reporting

indexes.name: idx_status
indexes.description: Index for filtering by delivery status

recipientEmail.description: Must be a valid email format
